notes.title: Adding Lights and Particles!
notes.content:
I have added [b]Lights[/b] and [b]Particle Effects[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42915113/a197a60e25717172d0fb0fc70cf956bbb2001bc5.gif[/img]

Everything's flashy and the Firefly buddy stands out more! ːsteamhappyː
Also each level is affected with morning, noon, evening or midnight mood.

Besides that:
[list]
[*] Many gameplay improvements
[*] HP replenishing bushes
[*] Another depth of parallax
[*] minor bug fixes
[/list]

Feel free to check in out in the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2115930]Demo[/url][/b]
